title: Extensionality on lifted wedges
statement: morphisms out of the tensor of exterior powers agree when they agree on wedges of locally lifted quotient sections.

proof.text: Use the characterization of exteriorSheafRestriction_existsUnique and naturality of the sheafification unit to show restriction of a wedge is the wedge of the restrictions. This is the fully proved private helper exterior_section_map.

For each point of U, apply TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi to the underlying abelian sheaf map of g. SheafOfModules.toSheaf preserves finite colimits, hence epis. Choose one neighborhood and lift for each of the finitely many c_i, take U intersected with their finite intersection, and restrict the lifts there. Naturality gives simultaneous lifts. When s=0 the intersection is top and the lift family is empty. Separatedness of D and the hypothesis then give equality on tensors of arbitrary pure wedges. This is finite_local_lifts and the local claim hpure in the Lean proof.

The sheafification unit of the exterior-power presheaf is locally surjective by GrothendieckTopology.W_toSheafify. On an image-sieve covering, choose a presheaf section; exteriorPower.ιMulti_span and Submodule.span_induction extend a property from pure wedges by zero, addition, and scalar multiplication. Apply this fully proved exterior_section_induction helper first to the second factor and then to the first, taking the property to be equality under φ and ψ. Naturality and separatedness verify local closure, and the bilinearity lemmas for tmulSection verify additive and scalar closure.

Identify the tensor sheaf with the sheafification of the presheaf tensor product using SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification. Apply the injectivity of the sheafification adjunction homEquiv; presheaf morphism extensionality and TensorProduct.induction_on reduce equality to elementary tensors, on which the preceding step applies. The fully proved private helper tensor_section_ext carries this final argument.

top exterior power of a finite locally free sheaf is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorTensor_lift_hom_ext {X : Scheme.{v}} {A B C D : X.Modules}
    (g : B ⟶ C) [Epi g] (r s : ℕ)
    (φ ψ : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf C s ⟶ D)
    (h : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin s → B.val.obj (op U)),
      φ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection C s U (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i)))) =
        ψ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection C s U (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i))))) :
    φ = ψ
